title: Perfect, heavy, solid mortar and pestle
text: Perfect, heavy, solid mortar and pestle. This is a fabulous mortar and pestle and does a really great job of grinding up rice, peppercorns, garlic ~ you name it!  I have yet to use it to make something specific as I have been conditioning it, but it is everything you could want in a mortar.  I have the 3-cup mortar and it is very heavy, so if weight is an issue, you may wish to get a smaller one.  The base of mine is nice and even, not at all wobbly, but I am using it on a towel anyway.  This shipped fairly quickly and I would rate it an excellent product.
